documents.title: Versioned public contracts and reproducible producer delivery — implementation

tasks.label: Record immutable implementation input authority
tasks.outcome: Extend existing packaging provenance with a committed integration input snapshot containing relevant source and toolchain hashes, archive payload hashes and explicit schema versions. Preserve unrelated staged/working changes; publish no dirty implementation. Documentation and counterpart qualification receipts outside the input set must not recursively invalidate the runtime archive; relevant source/payload changes always do.

tasks.label: Deliver authenticated registration and operation negotiation schemas
tasks.outcome: Extend the single local contract authority with bounded version/capability negotiation, registration-use purpose, delegation/grant references, workflow claim/renew/settle operations and exact command correlation. Preserve old signed bytes and old-protocol refusals; no actor/trust boolean or generic shell input. Use a compatible extension only when old consumers cannot misread it, otherwise negotiate a new version.

tasks.label: Add authoring and choice contract authority
tasks.outcome: Publish a bounded desktop policy projection contract for verified principal/installation/policy digest, create/edit/clone/import operations, allowed provider/model/account/workspace/tool/automation/credential references and locked/constrained/user-editable field states. Map the existing public Maestro managed settings schema through the early runtime artifact; secrets and host paths are not choices or identity authority.

tasks.label: Publish owned contract packaging entrypoints
tasks.outcome: Extend existing archive allowlist, exports and generated HTTP projections for the new contracts; preserve exact dependencies, SHA-256/SHA-512 and payload/input provenance. Emit consumer-readable protocol/features and immutable implementation snapshot identity without copying sibling source or private runtime state.

tasks.label: Correct application component metadata
tasks.outcome: Reuse isolated clean builds to package real endpoint/API/gateway entries, native ABI/platform fields, contracts archive digest and truthful supported producer versions. Make metadata use the schema the public consumer verifies; remove hardcoded unsupported adapter metadata only after a real matching producer exists. Do not introduce readiness flags.

tasks.label: Produce bounded integration artifact receipts
tasks.outcome: Create one manifest producer composing existing contract/application packagers and source snapshots. Receipts bind immutable inputs, actual archives and capabilities, and remain outside Maestro runtime archive inputs to avoid mutual qualification cycles. Verify content-addressed directories rather than trusting a path or version string; no --allow-dirty/stale route to certifiable delivery.

tasks.label: Author public archive and protocol compatibility regressions
tasks.outcome: Add behavioral archive/schema tests for old-version refusal, forged authority fields, unknown operations, missing export/payload, altered digest and coordination-only receipt changes. Test meaningful source changes invalidate the correct artifact while documentation alone cannot cause a pin cycle.

tasks.label: Verify and publish implementation inputs
tasks.outcome: Run the changed-module unit suites, type/build checks and public archive load/contract checks relevant to this phase. Fix failures through separate bounded IMPLEMENT/TEST continuations before retrying. Publish the actual clean implementation snapshot, payload/input hashes, public archives and commands/results in the BUILD receipt. This receipt supplies compiled inputs for the other owner; it grants no execution authority and proves no paired/native/provider support. Every paired, native and real-provider requirement remains in its separate qualification task.

documents.title: Versioned public contracts and reproducible producer delivery — qualification

tasks.label: Verify versioned public contracts and reproducible producer delivery
tasks.outcome: Run focused contracts/distribution tests, relevant strict compilation and existing isolated archivers on a reviewed committed input snapshot. Load exported schemas from the produced archive in plain Node, verify service entrypoints and native metadata, and emit MEGA-CONTRACTS-FOUNDATION with exact provenance. This is packaging readiness, not a passed pair or execution authority. Where the paired consumer BUILD supersedes the M0 archive, consume its actual new archive, rebuild this owner’s adapter/pins and rerun affected conformance before the pair. Preserve prior immutable archives; never substitute old qualifiedAgainst evidence for changed runtime bytes.
